name: ARRIVED
incident: Heart attack
officialReport: he suffered heart attack and died shortly after passing the winning post.

name: SUGRIVA
incident: Collapsed
officialReport: DNF: Explanation of Jockey B. Nikhil (SUGRIVA) that his mount whilst travelling in the mid bunch, suddenly collapsed, resulting in him getting dislodged from his mount. Since, the incident is purely an accidental and no individual can be attribute the blame, the Jockey who was given immediate aid, declared medically unfit for the remaining races of the day. The Jockey was shifted to Hospital for further check-up.

name: WHISPER
incident: Fracture of right fore fetlock joint
officialReport: In the final stages of the race, WHISPER (Vivek G.) was observed to have stopped galloping. On subsequent veterinary examination the filly was observed to have broken its right fore fetlock joint, with the consent of Trainer M. Narredu the filly was euthanized on humanitarian ground.

name: DAKSHA
incident: Fracture of right fore shoulder
officialReport: It was observed that DAKSHA (Abhishek Mhatre) pulled up lame approaching 150 Metres, in the process inconvenienced ZEBULA (A.Ayaz Khan) on its outside whereby the rider having to dismount before passing the winning post. On immediate examination by the Club’s Veterinary Officer, it was found to have sustained fracture of right fore shoulder. Hence, it was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.

name: ASTRID
incident: Complete fracture of hind leg cannon bone and rupture of tendon
officialReport: ASTRID (P.Trevor) suffered from complete fracture of hind leg cannon bone and rupture of tendon inside the horse float, while travelling from Bangalore to Mysore. Hence, the horse was taken back to Bangalore Turf Club and was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.

name: MANSA MUSA
incident: Injury on its left hind stifle along with a swelling at its left fore shoulder and a crepe sole
officialReport: Passing the 400 meters, MANSA MUSA (App. Aditya Waydande) was observed to have lost its footing and stumble thereby dislodging its rider. Subsequently, the gelding was examined by the Club’s Sr. V. O. and was found to have an injury on its left hind stifle along with a swelling at its left fore shoulder and a crepetah soul, accordingly treatment was administered in the Equine Hospital but as the gelding was unable to get up, with the consent of Trainer Behram Cama the gelding was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.

name: THUNDERING GREY
incident: Broke down and was put down
officialReport: THUNDERING GREY was observed to have broken down, with the consent of Trainer Narendra Lagad , the gelding was put down and a detailed medical report is awaited.

name: SD GOOD SAM
incident: Collapsed during the race and subsequently died due to EIPH
officialReport: Approaching the 200 Metres, SD GOOD SAM (A.R. Pradeep) collapsed during the race and subsequently died due to EIPH.

name: MAGNUM
incident: Collapsed and died
officialReport: MAGNUM (B. Nikhil) broke down in the final 100 meters resulting in Jockey being dislodged from the mount. Subsequent Veterinary examination revealed that the gelding collapsed and died.

name: KNOTTY CRUISE
incident: Fracture of left fore fetlock
officialReport: After passing the 300 meters, KNOTTY CRUISE (S.Sachin) fractured her left fore fetlock, stumbled and fell dislodging apprentice Sachin. KNOTTY CRUISE was humanely euthanized.

name: ABSOLUTE KESARI
incident: Complete hip bone fracture
officialReport: Jockey H. Rahul, the rider of ABOSLUTE KESARI reported that his mount stopped galloping in the final 200 Metres of the Race. The horse was subjected to veterinary examination. On examination, it was found to have suffered from heat stress and was stiff on its hind quarters. Subsequently on 18th June, 2026, the Club’s Veterinary Officer reported that the horse had sustained complete hip bone fracture and hence was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.

name: MASTER MULTITUDE
incident: Fracture in right hind limb
officialReport:
At behest of the Stipendiary Stewards a Stewards enquiry was called into the incident wherein MASTER MULTITUDE (Angad) suffered a fall, dislodging the rider just before passing the winning post.
As a consequent b m TEQUILA who was travelling behind shied away and dislodged App. Aasif Khan.
Since Jockey Angad was injured and could not attend the Stewards enquiry, The Stewards after watching the replay of the race and considered inputs of the Stipendiary Stewards decided that since MASTER MULTITUDE did not cross the finish line no alteration in the judges placing was required.
Veterinary Officer reported that MASTER MULTITUDE suffered a fracture in Right hind limb, hence the horse was euthanized on humane ground.

name: ACCUMULATE
incident: Broke his left fore leg
officialReport: At about 400 meters ACCUMULATE (Saurav Rawat) stumbled and fell down dislodging the rider. Veterinary officer reported that b g ACCUMULATE broke his left foreleg and was euthanized on humane grounds with consent of the Trainer.

name: MEDUSA
incident: Collapsed due to cardiac arrest
officialReport: DNF: At about 400 meters, MEDUSA (P. Trevor) was observed have stopped galloping and collapsed thereby dislodging its rider on subsequently, veterinary examination the mare was found to have a cardiac arrest due to which she collapsed.

name: HILMA KLINT
incident: Fractured both her fore fetlock joints
officialReport: At the 600 meters, HILMA KLINT (App. Mustakim Alam) was observed to have stumble and fell along with the rider, due to the incident MOMENT OF MADNESS (App. S. Siddharth), RISE ALL STARS (S. G. Prasad) and OH KAY (C. Umesh) were inconvenienced and had to check and change course. Subsequently, the mare was examined by the Club’s Sr. V.O. and was found to have fractured both its fore fetlock joints and with the consent of Trainer Narendra Lagad, the mare was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.

name: BLACK MAGICIAN
incident: Right shoulder of the colt was fractured
officialReport: Approaching the 200 meters, BLACK MAGICIAN (P. Trevor) was observed to have gone lame and therefore Jockey P. Trevor stopped riding the colt and dismounted, thereafter on veterinary examination it was suspected that the right shoulder of the colt was fractured. After first aid treatment the colt was sent to the Equine Hospital for further evaluation. Subsequently, the Equine Hospital confirmed that the right shoulder of the colt was fractured, as such, at the request of Trainer Hosidar Daji the colt was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.

name: SUPERLUMINAL
incident: Broken left fore radius bone with open fracture
officialReport: Passing the 500 meters, SUPERLUMINAL (R. Shelar) lost its footing, broke down and dislodged its rider, the filly was examined by the Club’s Sr. V.O. and was found to be recumbent with broken left fore radius bone with open fracture which was not repairable. As such, with the due consent of Trainer Ivor Fernandes the filly was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.

name: DAZZLING PRINCESS
incident: Complete fracture of Right fore fetlock
officialReport: DNF: The Club's Veterinary Officer reported after the race that DAZZLING PRINCESS (Bharat Mal) sustained complete fracture of Right fore fetlock during the race.

name: ROLE MODEL
incident: Collapsed at about the 950 meters
officialReport: DNF: Explanation of Jockey Abhay Singh (ROLE MODEL) that he felt uncomfortable with the horse, while trying to control, the horse stumbled and fell down and collapsed at about the 950 meters accidentally resulting in, him dislodging from the mount. The Jockey who was given immediate medical aid was declared medically unfit to ride for the remaining races of the day.

name: DOMINA
incident: Collapsed and died
officialReport: Jockey Anish Anamo Hangal, the rider of DOMINA reported that his mount stopped galloping in the final 150 Metres, thereby Jockey dismounted immediately after the winning post. On immediate examination by the clubs' Veterinary Officer, it was reported that DOMINA had collapsed and died.

name: UNNAMED HORSE
incident: Fracture(s)
officialReport: One crashed into the retaining wall, others fell or collided, leading to devastating injuries. Two had to be euthanized after suffering irreparable fractures;

name: UNNAMED HORSE
incident: Fracture(s)
officialReport: One crashed into the retaining wall, others fell or collided, leading to devastating injuries. Two had to be euthanized after suffering irreparable fractures;

name: UNNAMED HORSE
incident: Collapsed and died during morning workouts
officialReport: Yet another collapsed and died during morning workouts three days ago.

name: KNOTTY PATTON
incident: Rupture on left fore, suspensory apparatus with irreparable comminuted fracture on left fore medial sesamoid, medial splint and lateral
officialReport: It was observed that KNOTTY PATTON (Y. S. Srinath) pulled up lame at about 400 Metres & the rider having to dismount and did not complete the course. On immediate examination by the Club's Veterinary Officer, it was found to have sustained irreparable rupture on left fore, suspensory apparatus with irreparable comminuted fracture on left fore medial sesamoid, medial splint and lateral. Subsequently, it was euthanized at 05:20 P.M.

name: POSTHASTE
incident: Head injury and bleeding from both nostrils
officialReport: POSTHASTE (Dharshan Antony.B) flipped over while parading in the paddock and on immediate examination, it was found to have sustained head injury and bleeding from both nostrils. Hence, it was withdrawn on veterinary grounds. Subsequently, it was euthanized at 06:40 P.M.

name: UNNAMED HORSE
incident: Unknown
officialReport: Another one at the bund school.

name: DEUS EX MACHINA
incident: Burst its blood vessels and suffered a cardiac arrest and died
officialReport: It was observed that DEUS EX MACHINA (Hasib Alam) veered out passing the 350 Metres towards the outer sand track, dropped its rider and collapsed. On immediate examination by the Club’s Veterinary Officer it was reported to have burst its blood vessels and suffered a cardiac arrest and died. Blood sample was collected for analysis from the dead horse, viz., b g DEUS EX MACHINA.

name: MYSTICAL FOREST
incident: Acute Paraplegia
officialReport: Jockey R. Vaibhav, the rider of MYSTICAL FOREST reported that his mount was not galloping fluently throughout the race. The horse was subjected to veterinary examination. The Club’s Veterinary Officer reported that during examination after the race the horse wobbled and collapsed. Subsequently, necessary treatment was given to the horse, however, the horse was unable to get up due to acute Paraplegia. Hence, it was euthanized.

name: VIJAYA FALCON
incident: Comminuted fracture of left carpal bones
officialReport: It was observed that VIJAYA FALCON (Vishal N Bunde) accidentally struck the front runner REGAL REALITY (Akshay Kumar), Jockey Vishal N Bunde was totally unbalanced and was dislodged from his mount approaching 850 Metres. As the incident was accidental no action was taken beyond noting the incident. On immediate examination by the Club's Veterinary Officer, it was found that VIJAYA FALCON (Vishal N Bunde) pulled up lame on left fore. Subsequently, it was euthanized at 06:05 p.m. on 24/05/2025 as the gelding was suffering from comminuted fracture of left carpal bones.

name: AMADEUS
incident: Fractured its left fore fetlock joint
officialReport: AMADEUS broke down passing the 600 meters and was eased up by its rider. On examination the gelding was found to have fractured its left fore fetlock joint and was euthanized on the morning of 5th April, 2025 on humanitarian grounds.

name: ZACAPA
incident: Fractured its left fore fetlock and its right fore shoulder joint
officialReport: Approaching 800 meters, ZACAPA (App. Aditya Waydande) was observed to have lost its footing, stumbled and fell along with the rider. The Club’s Sr. V.O. reported that the gelding had Fractured its left fore fetlock and its right fore shoulder joint. As such, with due consent of Trainer Shazaan Shah the gelding was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.

name: SMASH SHOT
incident: Collapsed and died during the morning track work
officialReport: SMASH SHOT, an acceptor in the above race, collapsed and died during the morning track work on 1st April, 2024, as such the name of the gelding was withdrawn from the race.

name: FLEETWOOD
incident: Multiple fractures of carpal bones in the right fore knee
officialReport: FLEETWOOD (P. Vinod) pulled up lame before passing the winning post and took no practical part in the race. After the race, the filly was examined by the Club’s Sr. V.O. and was found to be sore by right fore. Subsequently, the filly was sent to the Equine Hospital for further diagnosis and after an x-ray it was found that the filly had multiple fractures of carpal bones in the right fore knee. As such, with the consent of Trainer Shazaan Shah the filly was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.

name: SWEET LEGACY
incident: Complete fracture of Right Tibia bone
officialReport: The Club's Veterinary Officer reported after the race that SWEET LEGACY (Hindu Singh)was euthanized near 800 meters marker with the consent of Trainer Vijay Singh as she pulled up ;lame on Right hind due to complete fracture of Right Tibia bone.

name: BLUE CHIP
incident: Right knee of the horse was fractured
officialReport: BLUE CHIP was observed to drop back rapidly from about the 700 meters. Veterinary examination revealed that the right knee of the horse was fractured. As the horse was in pain and agony, it was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.

name: SAND CASTLES
incident: Right fore lateral sesamoid (basal) comminuted fracture with rupture of suspensory apparatus
officialReport: It was observed that SAND CASTLES (Darshan R.N) accidently stumbled passing the 200 meters, thereby the rider was dislodged from his mount, thereafter the horse ran riderless. On immediate examination by the club's veterinary officer, it was found to be lame on right fore. Subsequently, it was euthanized at 8:20 a.m. on 19/01/2025 as the mare was suffering from Right fore lateral sesamoid (basal) comminuted fracture with rupture of suspensory apparatus.

name: ULTIMATE STRIKER
incident: Fracture of left shoulder (scapula)
officialReport: ULTIMATE STRIKER (Anish Anamo Hangal) was examined by the Club's Veterinary Officer immediately after the race and was found to have sustained an irreparable fracture of left shoulder (scapula). Hence, it was euthanized.

name: SUNNY ISLES
incident: Collapsed during the race resulting in severe head injury and hypovolemic shock
officialReport: SUNNY ISLES (Kuldeep Singh) was euthanized as she collapsed during the race resulting in severe head injury and hypovolemic shock.

name: GOLDEN NEIL
incident: Broken both fore fetlock joints
officialReport: Passing the 250 meters, GOLDEN NEIL (App. Mustakim Alam) was observed to have lost its footing and thereafter fell along with the rider. Further, the Sr. V.O. reported that the gelding had broken both fore fetlock joints. Hence, with the due consent of Trainer Narendra Lagad, the gelding was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.

name: DEO VOLENTE
incident: Hip fracture
officialReport: After the race, DEO VOLENTE was examined by the Club’s Sr. V.O. and was found to be sore by left hind. The filly was immediately shifted to the Equine Hospital for further treatment. On examination the filly was found to have a hip fracture. As such, at the Trainer’s request the filly was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.

name: TENALI
incident: Complete fracture of right hind femur with rupture of major artery, leading to sudden bleeding in scrotal, prepucial and inguinal region
officialReport: It was reported after the Race that TENALI (P Kiran Rai) sustained complete fracture of right hind femur with rupture of major artery, leading to sudden bleeding in scrotal, prepucial and inguinal region. Under the circumstances it was euthanized immediately on humanitarian grounds.

name: COLD PURSUIT
incident: Complete fracture of Right fore pastern
officialReport: COLD PURSUIT (L.Alex Rozario) was euthanized on humanitarian grounds as he sustained complete fracture of Right fore pastern during the race.

name: SARO EAGLE
incident: Complete fracture of Right fore cannon bone
officialReport:
Jockey Sah Farid Ansari, the rider of SARO EAGLE lost control of the reins passing the 1000 meters negotiating the 1st turn,lost balance and the mare slipped from its hind passing the 800 meters causing a fall and dislodging its rider.
The Club's Veterinary Officer reported after the race that SARO EAGLE was euthanized on humanitarian grounds as she had sustained complete fracture of Right fore cannon bone during the race.

name: JORDANO
incident: Multiple injuries on head, left shoulder, fore arm and died due to shock
officialReport: JORDANO (L. Alex Rozario) bolted before arrival to the paddock, ran helter skelter crashed against the inner sand track railing and fell. On immediate examination by the Club's Veterinary Officer it was found to have sustained multiple injuries on head, left shoulder, fore arm and died due to shock.

name: SNAPPER
incident: Fracture of the left humerus bone
officialReport: SNAPPER (P.Vikram) pulled up lame at the 600 meters.The Club's Veterinary Officer reported after the race that the colt was euthanized on humanitarian grounds due to a fracture of the left humerus bone.

name: HALLUCINATE
incident: Multiple fracture of Right humerus and Scapula (shoulder)
officialReport:
LOCH LOMOND (F.Norton) RUBERT (Imran Chisty) ROMUALDO (Inayat ) and HALLUCINATE (Sah Farid Ansari) who were in close bunch all fell down.
HALLUCINATE (Sah Farid Ansari) was euthanized in the trackon humanitarian grounds as she stumbled during the race resulting in multiple fractureof Right humerus and Scapula(shoulder).

name: BLUE BLOSSOM
incident: Fracture of left fore fetlock
officialReport: BLUE BLOSSOM (Mohammed Mushraf) broke down nearing 700 Metres and it was reported by the Club’s Veterinary Officer that the horse had sustained a fracture of left fore fetlock. As such, GUIDING FORCE (Anil Bandaal) had to shift `out’ to avoid the former and HERODOTUS (B Harish) had to be checked to slow down to avoid striking the front-runner, BLUE BLOSSOM (Mohammed Mushraf). Under the circumstance, the horse BLUE BLOSSOM was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.

name: EXCELLENT RAY
incident: Fracture of left scapula
officialReport: EXCELLENT RAY was subjected to veterinary examination and it was found to be lame on left fore. Subsequently, it was euthanized at 6.30 PM on 25.01.24 as the horse sustained irreparable fracture of Left scapula.

name: MAYFLOWER
incident: Collapsed during the race at about 900 meters and died
officialReport:
MAYFLOWER (D S Deora) stumbled and fell passing the 900 meters,due to which AVIOTHIC (A S .Peter) and BELLA NOIR (Hindu Singh) travelling right behind MAYFLOWER (D S Deora) had to check resulting in collision and all three were dislodged.
The Club's Veterinary Officer reported after the race that MAYFLOWER (D S Deora) collapsed during the race at about 900 meters and died.

name: VICTORY CHANT
incident: Fracture on its right shoulder
officialReport: Passing the 100 meters, it was observed that VICTORY CHANT (M. S. Deora) stumbled and fell along with the rider, the gelding was examined by the Club’s Sr. V.O. and was found to have a swelling due to a fracture on its right shoulder, as such, the gelding was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.
